text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-test-clippy:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true
          components: clippy,rustfmt

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Cache target directory
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-target-

      - name: Build release
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt -- --check

      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy -- -D warnings
```
